The stones are located in
^4D4DFFGate Houses^000000 which must be
protected to prevent enemies
from reaching the Emperium.
Guardian Stones can ^4D4DFFrecall
your Guardians^000000 for protection.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
守护石位于^4D4DFF守护石室^000000。必须保护这些地点，防止敌人接近华丽金属。守护石还能^4D4DFF召回你的守护者^000000协助防守。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fortresses with higher levels
of defense can summon more
Guardians: this is why it is
so important for guilds to
invest in Defense Growth.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
要塞的防御等级越高，就能召唤越多守护者。因此，公会投资提升防御等级非常重要。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guardian Stones that have
been destroyed can be revived
after a certain time, but one of the guild members must give
me the order. I can also report the status of the Guardian Stones.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
守护石被摧毁一段时间后可以复原，但必须由公会成员下令。我也可以报告守护石的状态。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4D4DFFFortress Gates^000000 are the second line of guild stronghold defense,
and are protected by extra barricades activated by the Guardian Stones.
These gates are located in three different parts of the fortress.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^4D4DFF要塞城门^000000是公会要塞的第二道防线，由守护石启动的额外路障保护。城门分布在要塞的三个区域。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Barricades are protected by
Guardian Stones, and are
restored when the Guardian
Stones are retrieved. However,
it is not as easy to restore
destroyed Fortress Gates.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
路障由守护石保护，守护石复原后路障也会恢复。不过，被摧毁的要塞城门就没那么容易修复了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fortress Gates can only be
restored when the ^4D4DFFguild
master of a stronghold
changes^000000, or if ^4D4DFFrestoration
is requested by the guild
master of the stronghold^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
只有更换要塞的^4D4DFF公会会长^000000，或由要塞公会会长^4D4DFF申请修复^000000，才能修复要塞城门。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Strongholds have many
Link Flags that allow you
to access vital areas within
restrictions placed by the
Barricades. Usually, ^4D4DFFFlag 1
links to the Gate House^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
要塞内有许多传送旗帜，可以让你在路障限制下前往重要区域。通常，^4D4DFF旗帜1连接到守护石室^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Many flags link directly to
the flag near the Emperium.
The final numbered flag is
linked to the Convenience
Facility of the stronghold's
owner. Keep this in mind.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
许多旗帜直接连接到华丽金属附近的旗帜。编号最大的旗帜则连接到要塞所有者的便利设施。记住这一点。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Strategy? It would be better
to develop your battle plan to
exploit your guild's advantages
and your enemies' weaknesses.
Use the Gate Houses and Barricades, and rebuild as quickly as you can!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
战略？最好制定作战计划，发挥公会的优势、针对敌人的弱点。善用守护石室和路障，并尽快重建防线！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You have no questions
to ask of me? Well, I'm
here to serve your needs.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你没有问题要问我吗？我随时为你效劳。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm always here, so
feel free to request my
assistance whenever
the need arises.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会一直在这里。有需要时，尽管找我帮忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Greetings, {1}.
What are your orders?
Increase Stronghold Defense
scripts.translation: 增强要塞防御

scripts.text: Situational Briefing
scripts.translation: 局势简报

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but the Guardian
Stones aren't powerful enough
to summon Guardians yet. We
need to accumulate more
knowledge before they can
summon any Guardians.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，守护石的力量还不足以召唤守护者。我们需要积累更多知识，才能召唤守护者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shall endeavor to summon
a Guardian through a Guardian
Stone. However, keep in mind
that this will not work if the
Guardian Stone is destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会尝试通过守护石召唤一名守护者。不过，若守护石已被摧毁，就无法召唤。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You've already commanded
me to summon a Guardian
to defend the stronghold.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你已经命令我召唤守护者来保护要塞了。

hold everything together.^000000

is badly damaged:
fixing this part
is a top priority.^000000
